# Structured Data Validation Service

## Purpose
Reviews public or client-approved structured data for syntax, consistency, and search presentation eligibility.

## Workflow
1. Identify page templates and the structured-data types actually supported by visible page content.
2. Inspect approved JSON-LD or rendered source.
3. Validate syntax, required and recommended properties, entity consistency, canonical URLs, and alignment between markup and visible content.
4. Record warnings separately from errors and avoid promising rich-result display.
5. Provide corrected examples for client review.

## Output
Page-type inventory, structured-data findings, corrected sample markup, and validation checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Do not add markup to production, fabricate reviews or claims, or guarantee search enhancements. Use public pages or authorized source only. No runtime activation or tool grants.
- Research, drafting, and planning only; execution requires a separate future approval and reviewed integration.

## Provenance
CEOAI-authored workflow. Intake candidate only.
